User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see the channel used for the last contact (Email / Call / SMS) next to each VIP in the tracker so that I understand how the relationship is being maintained.
Acceptance Criteria: Contact Source column displays a color-coded text pill: Email (blue) · Call (green) · SMS (purple) | Source is derived from the most recent qualifying 1-to-1 activity on the VIP's Contact or Asset record | Column is blank if no qualifying activity exists | Column renders between Last Contact date and Contact Note | Source value must match the same activity record driving the Last Contact date and Contact Note (same row, same event)

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want to see a truncated note from the last logged activity next to each VIP so that I have quick context on the last interaction without opening the full record.
Acceptance Criteria: Contact Note column displays the Description / Notes field from the most recent qualifying 1-to-1 activity | Note truncates at 45 characters with ellipsis (…) if longer | 'View' text link opens the full activity record in Salesforce (Task or EmailMessage record) in a new tab | Column is blank if no note exists on the last activity — no placeholder dash | Column has a max-width to prevent layout overflow on long notes

User Story: As a VIP KAM I want the Last Contact date to reflect only genuine 1-to-1 communications so that mass campaign sends do not mask VIPs I have not personally engaged with.
Acceptance Criteria: Last Contact is calculated from the most recent activity matching ALL of the following criteria: (1) Activity type is Email (logged or synced) · Call (logged) · or SMS (logged or synced); (2) Activity is associated to the VIP's Contact record or Asset record; (3) Activity is NOT linked to a Salesforce Campaign or Marketing Cloud send (campaign emails excluded) | Activities on other related records (e.g. Opportunity) do not qualify unless mirrored on Contact or Asset | Contact Source and Contact Note columns derive from the same qualifying activity record | Phase 1: mock seed data on Contact records; Phase 2: SOQL via ActivityDate on Task / EmailMessage filtered by WhoId (Contact) and Campaign flag = null | Cadence thresholds (14d In Cadence / 15–29d Due Soon / 30d+ Overdue) applied to this filtered Last Contact date
